chunk_text: When everyone sees Carlos, Carlos’ skin cycles until landing on a beautiful lady with mocha skin. Izar: “Do we still call you Carlos?” Carlos: “Hmm. You can call me… Ego.”
Izar has the egg stone and parchment. Ego recognizes it! It is from the diagram of the Solar Cannon in the Codex. It’s one of the nine power cells needed to charge the Cannon.
Hrothulf learned about his family. “I learned my family has somewhat been reduced.”
Ego tries to communicate with Atchi. “Atchi, how are things going out there?” “Ah, well, I got Scruffy in check like three or four different times.”
We are in the Thestal Halls of Heorot(!) There are two floors. In the middle is a courtyard that is also a balcony at the higher level.
We start in room 1 (though DM is adamant that the number system is arbitrary and just for us, and has no hidden meaning). Inside is an elegant bathhouse and spa.
The scene as it stands: bots encroaching seemingly nonstop, 3 bombs placed and armed, obnoxious buzzing of the island.
Hrothulf rage-attacks the nearest bot between himself and Izar with Watermelon’s Wail, and the bot is obliterated.

Character Name: Ego

Description: A Slaad who once went by Carlos.
